text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Pittsburgh Steelers for their home opener on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET, the team faces a significant challenge: wide receiver A.J. Brown has been placed on injured reserve with a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, sidelining him for a minimum of four games, which means Mike Reiss and other beat writers are closely examining who steps up in his absence during training. Off the field, there's been plenty of positive news—Drake Maye and his wife Ann Michael surprised teachers at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence by funding the Amazon classroom wish lists of more than 50 educators, while the Kraft family and Patriots Foundation donated $275,000 in the names of this year's Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, including a $25,000 grand prize for Susie Shaw of Carlisle for William's Be Yourself Challenge. On the roster front, the Patriots re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad while releasing tight end Shane Zylstra from it.
